Initialize the Node.js project
npm init -y

Install the required packages

npm install express cors dotenv pg @google/genai zod bcryptjs jsonwebtoken cookie-parser
npm install -D typescript tsx @types/node @types/express @types/cors @types/pg @types/jsonwebtoken @types/cookie-parser vitest supertest @types/supertest

Install TypeScript configuration

npx tsc --init
